close_reason: handle_filenode_copy now parses on_destroy_remove_children + on_exists + compare_case_insensitively (matching handle_filenode_set's parsing exactly) and applies the Reject/Replace/Rename branches against the destination account. Cascade-destroy honors on_destroy_remove_children. Five integration tests in tests/filenode_tests.rs exercise the full matrix end-to-end against MemoryBackend. Follow-up gap (RFC silence on destroyed field for Foo/copy responses) filed as bd:JMAP-510h.55 with human label. Committed in 59ecb36. Gates: fmt/clippy/test/doc green; full workspace test suite green.
description:
draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 §3.2.4: 'This is a standard Foo/copy function with the same additional top-level arguments as FileNode/set, onDestroyRemoveChildren and onExists, with the same behaviour.'

The current handle_filenode_copy (src/filenode.rs:737-882) parses fromAccountId, accountId, ifInState, and the create map, then for each copy entry: fetches the source node via get_objects, applies parentId/name overrides from obj_val, and calls create_object. It does NOT parse onExists, compareCaseInsensitively, or onDestroyRemoveChildren, and it does NOT perform collision detection via find_sibling_by_name.

Trigger: client sends FileNode/copy with onExists='rename' to copy a node whose name already exists at the destination. Bad behavior: instead of renaming, the backend create_object returns alreadyExists SetError, surfacing under notCreated. The client sees a copy failure that the spec says MUST succeed.

The README (lines 195-197) and PLAN.md (§3.2.4 'FileNode/copy shares top-level arguments with FileNode/set') both explicitly claim this is implemented.

Required: replicate the onExists / compareCaseInsensitively / onDestroyRemoveChildren handling block from handle_filenode_set (src/filenode.rs:155-179, 213-367) inside handle_filenode_copy, using the destination account_id for find_sibling_by_name (NOT from_account_id).
title: handle_filenode_copy ignores onExists / compareCaseInsensitively / onDestroyRemoveChildren
